tools.name: find_similar_appeals
tools.description: Find source-linked recent Board decisions mentioning one or more canonical conditions. Resolves exact names, slugs and aliases; inspects at most the 50 most recent indexed decisions per condition, then applies optional decision-level filters. tools.name: check_presumptive_conditions
tools.description: Check whether a condition may be a PRESUMPTIVE service connection for a veteran — meaning VA presumes it is service-connected for qualifying service/exposure, so no medical nexus needs to be proven. tools.name: explain_appeal_options
tools.description: Explains the VA review options for a decision stage. Initial/Supplemental, Higher-Level Review and final Board decisions have different options, and a preference for a hearing or new evidence does not establish eligibility. Tailored options are returned only when the decision stage and ordinary mode

tools.name: find_accredited_rep
tools.description: Finds VA-accredited representatives for a disability claim or appeal, filtered by state, city and type. tools.name: estimate_combined_rating
tools.description: Calculate a veteran’s VA combined disability rating from individual ratings, using the official whole-person formula (38 CFR § 4.25) — ratings do NOT add (e.g. 50% + 30% combines to 65% and rounds to 70%, not 80%).
